title: Pondering Pearlfin Puffer
statement: A thumb-sized pufferfish with a translucent, pearly belly who collects tiny glinting pebbles and arranges them into spirals on the sand floor, then hovers back to admire her work with a slow, satisfied blink. Her tank is a hushed, lamplit blue-green with drifting motes of light, soft ferns swaying in the current, and a half-buried teacup that serves as her gallery.
